Table 1 summarises the benchmark runs from the last release cycle. Each row records a single run of the corpus across one worker pool; the throughput column is expressed in cells per second and the float column is the ratio of passed runs to attempted runs.

| Worker pool | Cells/s | Tail ms | Passed | Attempted | Ratio  |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ------ | --------- | ------ |
| small       | 41.20   | 38.1    | 120    | 120       | 1.0000 |
| medium      | 38.47   | 41.9    | 114    | 118       | 0.9661 |
| large       | 33.02   | 55.7    | 87     | 91        | 0.9560 |
| gpu         | 61.88   | 27.3    | 90     | 92        | 0.9783 |
| archive     | 12.05   | 109.2   | 45     | 49        | 0.9184 |
